title: All-temperature pressure for orthogonally invariant Ising spin glasses
main_claim: For U_N Haar on O(N) and deterministic diagonal Λ_N whose spectral law converges to a compactly supported μ with no outliers, the pressure (1/N) log 2^{-N} Σ_σ exp(½σᵀUᵀΛUσ) converges in expectation and almost surely to inf_{p∈P} {S(p)+G_1(p)}. Here S(p)=sup_h{ℓ(h)+½∫p h} is a Legendre-type Parisi one-site functional, and G_1(p)=½∫_0^1 R(D_p(r))dr, with R the edge-extended R-transform of μ.
coverage:
I read Sections 1–6 in full; Section 7 (external-field extension) I only skimmed. Checks done by hand:
(i) Spectral Ward identities (Prop. 3.x, rot:ward): rotation generator, Gibbs-derivative coefficients, perturbation error orders.
(ii) Replica-product lemma: rederived the conditional law of (Q13,Q23) given Q12 from GG plus ultrametricity, and matched it to formula (rot:product-path).
(iii) Solution of the symbol equations: ρ_a/α_a + tλ_a = b, so α_a = f_a(x); also the root equations.
(iv) Energy formula: ∂_t R_{tμ}(x) = Σλ_a f_a'(x), consistent with ∂_t G_t = E_t; F_t convexity via Cauchy–Schwarz.
(v) Upper bound: J_N(0,h) ≥ −Ce_N from the definition of S; lower bound on t_N; field-cap estimate, including the Abel summation Σζ_i(h_i−h_{i−1}) = h_{k−1} − Σw_ih_i; sign of the h-derivative (diagonal cancels against −Nh_{k−1}/2); tail order ⇒ D_p ≤ D_q ⇒ energy order; t-variation contradiction.
(vi) Cavity coupling: dimension count R_a ⊕ V_N = R^N, so the base gets multiplicity k_a(N); the identity Z_{N+n} = Z_N⟨W_N⟩ is exact; the special frames are uniform and independent by transitivity of the product group.
(vii) Quadratic-tilt lemma: (I − Δ_iK_i) = (I − H_{i−1}K)J_i; J_iT_i = J_{i−1}; the Gaussian square completion; the root term and determinant telescoping against −½∫f'(D_p).
(viii) Schur-complement identities: det(bI−A) = x^n Π(b−λ_a)^n and C + LᵀH̃L = R(x)I; the derivative xR'(x); residual and log-cosh contributions; the integration by parts to G_1(p).
(ix) Field concavity: the M-matrix argument with mixed-sign and radial-monotonicity lemmas; the domain bound for S (majorant g_d and the rearrangement step).
(x) Self-consistency B_{h_p} = p, including the plateau-measurability argument, and the supporting inequality ⇒ S(p) = ℓ(h_p) + ½∫p h_p.
(xi) Finite-alphabet removal: multiplicity comparison lemma, bin squeeze, continuity of the edge-extended R; the Wishart and ground-state corollaries.
As a sanity check, the formula reduces to the Parisi formula for SK (semicircle μ, h = β²p).
sibling_notes: The family 234 board was empty when I started.
